name: Marquee
description:
The Marquee component displays continuously scrolling content, horizontally or vertically, with optional stylized edges. It is composed of several primitives that enable customization and flexibility in its usage.

The Marquee component can be used to showcase logos, announcements, or any repeating content. It supports controlling the spacing, speed, direction, and loop count of the animation, and can pause when users hover or focus on it.

parts.name: El
parts.description: An entry abstraction for rendering all the content-related primitives and optional edges

props.name: edges
props.description: The edges to display over the marquee. `both` shows the start and end edges for the current `side`.

props.name: id
props.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the marquee. Useful for composition.

props.name: translations
props.description: The localized messages to use.

props.name: side
props.description: The side/direction the marquee scrolls towards.

props.name: speed
props.description: The speed of the marquee animation in pixels per second.

props.name: delay
props.description: The delay before the animation starts (in seconds).

props.name: loopCount
props.description: The number of times to loop the animation (0 = infinite).

props.name: spacing
props.description: The spacing between marquee items.

props.name: autoFill
props.description: Whether to automatically duplicate content to fill the container.

props.name: pauseOnInteraction
props.description: Whether to pause the marquee on user interaction (hover, focus).

props.name: reverse
props.description: Whether to reverse the animation direction.

props.name: paused
props.description: Whether the marquee is paused.

props.name: defaultPaused
props.description: Whether the marquee is paused by default.

props.name: onPauseChange
props.description: Function called when the pause status changes.

props.name: onLoopComplete
props.description: Function called when the marquee completes one loop iteration.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Function called when the marquee completes all loops and stops. Only fires for finite loops (loopCount > 0).

props.description: PandaCSS style object for custom atomic styling. All PandaCSS style props (e.g. p, bg, color) are also accepted.

members.name: multiplier
members.description:
The multiplier for auto-fill. Indicates how many times to duplicate content.
When autoFill is enabled and content is smaller than container, this returns
the number of additional copies needed. Otherwise returns 1.

members.name: contentCount
members.description:
The total number of content elements to render (original + clones).
Use this value when rendering your content in a loop.

members.name: restart
members.description: Restart the marquee animation from the beginning.
